falt.contentDescription: This advertisement, run by the Facebook page "Bustatio-busto" (page ID 262424923617670), reproduces our copyrighted advertising material without authorisation. The ad's video is a re-upload of our own ad film "Balteslipmaskin_G_1" (published by us on 21 August 2026, before this ad started running on 23 September 2026), with the same edit and our Swedish on-screen text at the same timestamps; the advertiser has added its own watermark. 3 still frames from different scenes of the reported video (at 0:11, 0:16, 0:21) are identical to frames of our film, including our on-screen text (perceptual-hash distance 0, 0, 0/64). Our original ad is public in Meta's Ad Library: "Balteslipmaskin_G_1" https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?id=2048782039094883. According to the Ad Library it has reached approximately 5,909 people in the EU. It copies our ad "Balteslipmaskin_G_1" for the product "Bälteslipmaskin Mini 3-i-1 – Knivslip & Polerare", which our page ran before this ad appeared. This is report 2 of 6 concerning ads from the same advertiser; each ad is reported separately.
falt.originalWorkDescription: Original advertising film edited by Stonebite Ecom AB for our store https://baverbutiken.se (product: "Bälteslipmaskin Mini 3-i-1 – Knivslip & Polerare"): "Balteslipmaskin_G_1".
